Gentle Dental Clinic

Design
Country:
Dubai
Start Date:
10/30/2025
Designer:

OVERVIEW

Gentle Dental Clinic brand guideline project set out to elevate the clinic’s visual identity into something calm, professional, and reassuring. It maintained the clinic’s core branding elements while refining them for better clarity and consistency. The guideline now supports multi-channel use, including signage, print materials, social media posts, and digital assets. It includes a cohesive color palette, typography system, iconography, and imagery style that together enhance trust and recognition.
